name: IntegrateIT Bond Shade
notes: Local Control4 control of one Bond Home motorized shade (device type MS) over the Bond v2 HTTP API: open, close, stop/hold, preset, and set-position where the shade reports position — otherwise an honest CourseTime assumed-position model for the RF shades that report nothing back. State arrives by BPUP UDP push (port 30007) with a hash-gated poll fallback, published as POSITION, STATE, and DEVICE_ONLINE.
